items.item_text: 01. Describe how you meet the minimum qualifications for this position. In your response, please include (A) Your total years of experience performing clerical accounting or book keeping duties, and where you gained it; (B) The main accounting duties you performed in those roles; and (C) Your education, if applicable. (300 words or fewer)

02. Describe your experience in accounts payable, including the types of invoices you have processed (e.g., purchase orders, reimbursements, claims) and your experience working with databases and enterprise financial systems. If you have no work experience in any of these areas, please respond “N/A.” (300 words or fewer)

03. I understand that SBCEO has an in-person work culture, and this position is designated as fully in-person at the site listed on the position announcement and may require travel throughout the county. I also understand that any request for a remote work arrangement will be reviewed in accordance with applicable laws and SBCEO’s remote work policy and procedure. Remote work arrangements are granted at SBCEO’s sole discretion. Options: Yes | No

04. SBCEO operates under the California Merit System, meaning that promotions are achieved only through competitive examination, not automatic progression or supervisory discretion. Do you acknowledge and understand that advancement occurs only through the Merit System competitive process? Options: Yes | No

05. Initial placement will occur within the salary range $5,867 - $6,761 per month based on experience, education, and internal alignment. Do you acknowledge and understand the salary range and initial placement process? Options: Yes | No
